decisions.statement: A refusal answers with the reasons given and reports nothing.
What was mistaken is said before what was wrong.
A call with anything mistaken is refused as a fault of the call.
A fault of the data alone is said as the one line naming it.
A call wrong with nothing mistaken is refused as a fault of the data.
Nothing mistaken and nothing wrong is no refusal at all.
Nothing here works out what is mistaken or wrong.
The answer is built by the one function that builds a command's refusal.
Each code is read from the page declaring what an exit code means.

definition: a command's answer where the call is refused
